purpose: 无障碍与尺度分析板 — 轮椅+触觉铺装+低位柜台+宽门+扶手
prompt: Accessibility and scale analysis board for visitor center. Clean architectural diagram showing universal design features. Wheelchair user navigating ramp with gentle slope (≤1:12). Tactile paving strips (warm-amber #D4A853) on floor. Low service counter (≤750mm height) with knee clearance. Wide doorways (≥900mm). Accessible restroom with grab bars. Clear wayfinding signage at multiple heights. Elderly visitor with cane using handrail. Child at lower eye level. Human scale figures showing different user types: wheelchair user, elderly person, adult, child, family group. Dimensional annotations showing key measurements. Whitewash (#F2EDE4) background, tile-grey (#4A4A48) outlines, water-cyan (#7BA3A0) accessibility highlights. Clean technical drawing style with generous whitespace. Song typeface labels in Chinese and English. Palette: whitewash #F2EDE4, tile-grey #4A4A48, water-cyan #7BA3A0, warm-amber #D4A853. No steep ramps, no inaccessible features, no dark background, no cluttered layout.
negative_prompt: Steep ramps, inaccessible features, dark background, cluttered layout, no dimension annotations, no human figures, no accessibility features shown
